messages:
tara_mkt: Quick sync — finalizing publish for the 'Latency-Sensitive Deployment' post tomorrow 9:00 AM PT. Need embargo note, CEO quote, and one-sheeter for press.
ben_pr: Got it. Embargo time? Also need the one-line angle for outreach.
tara_mkt: Embargo until 9:00 AM PT. Angle: 'Redwood Inference launches guidance for latency-sensitive LLM deployments that preserve SLOs while reducing cost.'
raj_eng: Uploaded perf charts + methodology to /shared/launches/latency-sensitive. Use `scripts/export_assets.sh` if you need different formats. Method blurb: 'Benchmarked live-like traffic for three model sizes; reported p95/p99 latencies, throughput, and cost/token.'
ben_pr: Draft CEO quote: "We want teams to meet latency SLOs without breaking the bank." @kevin_ceo please review.
kevin_ceo: Edit: prefer "meet latency SLOs while controlling inference spend." Approve.
ava_support: Support will monitor social and support channels for the first 3 hours. Share the internal FAQ and triage channel link when you send the embargo.
tara_mkt: FAQ link: https://drive.redwood/support/faq/latency-launch.pdf. CMS frontmatter: `launch_ready: true`, staging `noindex: true`.
publish-bot: Publish job scheduled: job_id=latency-launch-176800, scheduled_time=1768003200, embargo=true.
ben_pr: I'll send embargo email to press list at 4:30 PM PT and offer interviews. Do not comment publicly before go-live.
tara_mkt: I'll post final "ready" here at 4:15 PM PT. Thanks all. :rocket:
